regions.name: Crossroads
regions.description: An abandoned crossroads surrounded by dead trees. Old signs point toward forgotten lands.

regions.name: Ashen Marsh
regions.description: A vast swamp covered in thick grey fog. Strange noises emerge from beneath the muddy waters.

regions.name: Blackpine Forest
regions.description: A dark forest where sunlight never reaches the ground. Something watches travelers between the ancient trees.

regions.name: Drowned Chapel
regions.description: An ancient chapel swallowed by the swamp. Its broken bells ring at night, although nobody remains inside.

regions.name: Ironfang Quarry
regions.description: An abandoned mining site filled with rusted machinery and unstable tunnels. Something massive lives underground.

regions.name: Hollow Catacombs
regions.description: An endless network of underground tombs. Ancient warriors rise from their graves to protect a forgotten secret.

regions.name: The Black Citadel
regions.description: A massive fortress built from black stone. Dark magic fills its halls, and a terrible presence rules from the highest tower.
